name: app-orange-marketplace-app-two-phones-on-corrugated-backdrop
title: Orange Marketplace Phones on Ribbed Backdrop
whatItIs: Two black-framed phones showing an orange and white shopping home and search screen, standing before a peach ribbed panel backdrop with a white block at the base and a logo at top left.
whatItMeans: Orange gradients and vertical ribs feel warm and energetic, and the two screens show home and search together.
techniques: Ribbed vertical texture behind the phones
Gradient orange banner as hero card
Two screens at slightly different heights
Product cut-outs in a clean grid

vocabulary.definition: A vertically fluted surface used as a scene background.
A block used as a display base.
Two related screens shown side by side.
